concerns.text: Task T022 [US2] (train static model) lists a **BLOCKED BY** dependency on T015a (ground‑truth DelTA coefficients) which is produced in User Story 1. This creates a cross‑story data dependency, violating the lens rule that *each user‑story block must be independently shippable*.

Tasks T021d‑Gen, T021d, T021b, and T021c are marked as part of US2/Control but depend on T013 and T012 (produced in User Story 1). This again couples US2 to US1, breaking the independent‑story requirement.
